traceability.notes:
docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md defines cross-cutting requirements for clear, specific, and consistent error messages across all traceability rules, along with severity conventions and edge-case handling.
Review of the implementation and tests shows: - Each of the named rules implements `meta.messages` with message templates that match the story’s conventions (function name placeholders, branch `missingAnnotation` messages, `Invalid annotation format: {{details}}.`, and file/requirement diagnostics with `path`/`storyPath` and `reqId`). - The helper functions for `require-story-annotation` provide detailed, actionable messages, correct data payloads (`name`, `functionName`), and ESLint suggestions, with a dedicated test (`tests/rules/error-reporting.test.ts`) verifying this wiring end-to-end. - `require-req-annotation`, `require-branch-annotation`, `valid-annotation-format`, `valid-story-reference`, and `valid-req-reference` all have JSDoc annotations tying their error messages to this story and are covered by tests that assert the expected `messageId`, data fields, and, where applicable, auto-fix behavior. - Error handling for filesystem issues and configuration problems is implemented and validated, ensuring diagnostics instead of crashes and providing contextual error details. - Plugin configuration in `src/index.ts` enforces the severity scheme described in the story (errors for missing annotations/references, warnings for format issues), and this is validated by tests.
Given the comprehensive implementation, explicit story references throughout the code, and the passing targeted tests for all listed requirements, this story is fully implemented and verified. Therefore the assessment status is PASSED.
